segments.t: Five minutes later around the glowing sunroom lamp, Mei, Song, and Peng gather over the open blue-and-brass tin box, each holding one small keepsake from their unforgettable week. Let us listen in first.
头一样放进盒子里的是完整版浆果杏仁蛋糕方子——上下两半合璧啦！
你不仅过塑封得严严实实，还用粗字写着蜂蜜和甜橙皮？！
三十个夏天后的烘焙师值得一张不晕墨、也不沾菜汤的方子！
接下来，这儿是一份签了名的小院华尔兹和四手联弹乐谱。
这是我和志豪的：九号桦木衣夹，背面签满了大伙儿的名字！
哎呀，快看八号房制图老先生托宋老师带进来压轴的东西！
咱们刚才弹琴的时候，他用炭笔把灯笼底下的二十八个人全画下来了！
快看炭笔画里站在门口假装没笑的老陈！
角落里再塞一小包晒干的院子薄荷叶，留点清香。
三十年后，有人掀开这个盖子，就会闻见暖暖的夏茶香。
盖子压严实，盒边绕一圈白布胶带——可以包黄蜂蜡布啦！
趁第三块青石板还等着，咱们端出去到灯笼底下吧！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
头一样放进盒子里的是完整版浆果杏仁蛋糕方子——上下两半合璧啦！

'First into the box goes the complete berry almond cake recipe—both halves reunited!' "Tou yi yang" means "the very first item", and "hebi" is a classic idiom for bringing two matching halves back together.
你不仅过塑封得严严实实，还用粗字写着蜂蜜和甜橙皮？！

'Did you even laminate it waterproof-tight AND write honey and orange zest in bold letters?!' "Guosu" names "laminating in plastic", while "yanyanshishi" emphasizes sealing every edge completely tight.
三十个夏天后的烘焙师值得一张不晕墨、也不沾菜汤的方子！
'Bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve a recipe with zero smudged ink and zero soup drips!' "Yunmo" describes ink bleeding on paper, while "zhan caitang" means "getting splattered with soup".
接下来，这儿是一份签了名的小院华尔兹和四手联弹乐谱。
'Next up, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet score.' "Jiexialai" hands off smoothly to "next in line", presenting the signed "yuepu" ("musical score").
这是我和志豪的：九号桦木衣夹，背面签满了大伙儿的名字！

'And from Hao and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed across the back by everyone!' "Qian man le" pairs "sign" with "full" so every inch of the back is covered, and "dahuor" is warm everyday speech for "everyone".
哎呀，快看八号房制图老先生托宋老师带进来压轴的东西！
'Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker sent in with Teacher Song to crown the box!' "Tuo" means "entrust someone to deliver", and "yazhou" originally meant the show-stopping finale on stage.
咱们刚才弹琴的时候，他用炭笔把灯笼底下的二十八个人全画下来了！

'While we were playing piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the lanterns in charcoal!' "Tanbi" combines "charcoal" and "pen/brush" for a drawing stick, capturing everyone with "hua xialai" ("sketched down on paper").
快看炭笔画里站在门口假装没笑的老陈！

'Look at Chen in the charcoal sketch standing by the doorway pretending not to smile!' "Jiazhuang" means "pretend", catching Chen trying to keep a straight face while standing "zai menkou" ("in the doorway").
角落里再塞一小包晒干的院子薄荷叶，留点清香。
'Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves into the corner for a fresh scent.' "Sai" means "tuck snugly into a tight spot", leaving behind "qingxiang" ("clean, light fragrance").
三十年后，有人掀开这个盖子，就会闻见暖暖的夏茶香。

'Thirty years from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.' "Xiankai" captures lifting a lid or cover open, followed by "wenjian" ("catch a whiff of") for smelling the mint right away.
盖子压严实，盒边绕一圈白布胶带——可以包黄蜂蜡布啦！

'Lid pressed snug, white cloth tape wrapped around the rim—ready for the yellow waxed cloth!' "Rao" means "wind around", pairing with "yi quan" ("one full loop") to wrap the rim before sealing it in beeswax linen.
趁第三块青石板还等着，咱们端出去到灯笼底下吧！
'Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!' Mei pairs "chen" ("while") with "hai" ("still") to hurry everyone outside before the evening cools.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
头一样放进盒子里的是完整版浆果杏仁蛋糕方子——上下两半合璧啦！

快看炭笔画里站在门口假装没笑的老陈！
角落里再塞一小包晒干的院子薄荷叶，留点清香。
三十年后，有人掀开这个盖子，就会闻见暖暖的夏茶香。
盖子压严实，盒边绕一圈白布胶带——可以包黄蜂蜡布啦！
趁第三块青石板还等着，咱们端出去到灯笼底下吧！
A waterproof recipe, a rescued song, clothespin number nine, and a charcoal portrait rest safe inside the new tin! See you in the courtyard next time.
再见！
